from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class DocumentInfo(BaseModel):
    """Extracted information from a single judgment document relevant to classification."""
    document_title: str | None = Field(description="The exact title or identifier of the judgment document as found in the text")
    cause_of_action: str | None = Field(description="The specific legal cause of action or dispute type mentioned (e.g., '案外人执行异议之诉', '侵权责任纠纷')")
    case_nature: str | None = Field(description="High-level category of the case (e.g., 'Civil', 'Administrative', 'Criminal')")
    key_parties: list[str] = Field(description="Names of key parties involved in the case")
    key_facts: list[str] = Field(description="Brief facts of the case or specific disputes relevant to the cause of action")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    """Aggregation of extracted document information for the task."""
    documents: list[DocumentInfo]
